definitions.explanation: A method or technique, especially one requiring special training or knowledge. Often used as a suffix to form compound words describing specific arts or techniques.
A way or means of doing something, often used in the expression 'having no means' or 'no way to do something.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{忍術|にんじゅつ}→忍術：12849_ninjutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{柔術|じゅうじゅつ}→柔術：20990_juujutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{武術|ぶじゅつ}→武術：13244_bujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Jujutsu is one of Japan's traditional martial arts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{話術|わじゅつ}→話術：21732_wajutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|た}けていて→長ける：14540_takeru⟧、⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}きつける。
examples.english: He is skilled in the art of conversation and draws listeners in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧{術|じゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no way to escape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧{術|じゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To learn the means to survive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{為|な}す→為す：03915_nasu⟧{術|じゅつ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧しかなかった。
examples.english: There was nothing we could do; we could only watch.

notes:
{術|じゅつ} can function both as a standalone noun and as a suffix forming compound words.

COMMON COMPOUNDS (as suffix):
- ⟦{武術|ぶじゅつ}→武術：13244_bujutsu⟧ (martial arts)
- ⟦{忍術|にんじゅつ}→忍術：12849_ninjutsu⟧ (ninjutsu)
- ⟦{柔術|じゅうじゅつ}→柔術：20990_juujutsu⟧ (jujutsu)
- ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ (surgery)
- ⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧ (art)
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (technology, skill)
- ⟦{話術|わじゅつ}→話術：21732_wajutsu⟧ (art of conversation)
- ⟦{魔術|まじゅつ}→魔術：17994_majutsu⟧ (magic, sorcery)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS (sense 2):
- ⟦{為|な}す→為す：03915_nasu⟧{術|じゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (there is nothing one can do)
- ⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧{術|じゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (there is no way to escape)

Note: When reading {術|じゅつ} as すべ (an alternative reading), the meaning is specifically "means" or "way" and is more literary. The じゅつ reading is standard in compounds.
